blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — At least two House of Representatives lawmakers have called out their former colleague, ex-Cavite Rep. Kiko Barzaga, for his disrespectful statements on the death of Batanes Rep. Ciriaco Gato Jr. In a press briefing on Friday, Manila Rep. Joel Chua said Barzaga is rude for a nepo baby — a term used for politicians who supposedly benefited from relatives who used to be in office. Barzaga is the son of the late Cavite Rep. Elpidio Barzaga and recently-elected Rep. Jenny Barzaga. Since Gato’s death last Sept. 21, the younger Barzaga has made several posts claiming that the lawmaker’s passing is good news, […]...
